feats.title: Ruthless Efficiency
feats.description: You gain the Ruthless Ruffian class feature.

feats.title: Sly Dodge
feats.description: Once per encounter, when an enemy makes an opportunity attack against you, you can add your Charisma to your AC against that attack.

feats.title: Twilight Adept
feats.description: Once per encounter, you can use a free action during your turn to gain the benefit of the Rogue class feature Cunning Sneak until the end of your turn.

feats.title: Sneak of Shadows
feats.description: Once per encounter, you can use the Rogue's Sneak Attack class feature.
